subject: general
question: What is one of the interventions included in the rural development programmes?

options.text: Providing road connectivity to unconnected villages

solution:
The correct answer is __**Providing road connectivity to unconnected villages**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Road connectivity to unconnected villages** is a crucial part of rural development initiatives under schemes like the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY).
 
• PMGSY was launched in **2000** to provide all-weather road access to rural areas, aiming to boost economic activities and improve access to education, healthcare, and markets.
 
• The scheme specifically targets villages with a population of **500 or more** in plain areas and **250 or more** in hill states, tribal areas, and deserts.
 
• Improved road connectivity helps in reducing isolation, facilitating faster transportation of goods, and enabling better access to government services.
 
• As per reports from the Ministry of Rural Development, PMGSY has connected **over 97% of eligible habitations** by 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)**

 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Rural Development to improve rural road connectivity.
 
• Funded jointly by the central and state governments.
 
• Focuses on building roads with all-weather standards.
 
• Involves advanced technologies like **GIS mapping** to monitor progress.
 
 
 
• **Rural Development Programmes**
 
 
• Aimed at improving living standards in villages through infrastructure, education, healthcare, and employment generation.
 
• Key initiatives include **MNREGA, PMGSY, and NRLM** (National Rural Livelihood Mission).
 
 
 
• **Impact of Road Connectivity**
 
 
• Enhances access to markets, leading to better income for farmers and artisans.
 
• Improves healthcare accessibility during emergencies.
 
• Facilitates education by reducing travel time for students.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Implementation**
 
 
• Geographical barriers in hilly or forested areas.
 
• Delays due to lack of funds or coordination between agencies.
 
• Maintenance issues post-construction.
